scope: Cathy Chinese 3:4 covers explicitly using the earlier top-brand / bottom-title layout
basis: Historical user request for equal top-brand group width; later title-top and bottom-signature mode has independent geometry
group: Official brand lockup + Interview | guest name
measure: Union of the full group ink bounds, including internal spacing; exclude external transparent padding, screenshot margins, glow and shadow
resize: Uniform scale of the whole group; preserve logo proportions and internal type relationships
height: Derived from group aspect ratio; no fixed font size or header height

placement.existing_cover: Preserve the approved top-left anchor unless the user also requests moving it

exclude: Do not automatically apply this portrait-series width preset to English landscape covers or other named templates
